**Team Reporting:** Entire Sales and Product Support teams

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, technically competent and results-oriented Manager – Operations to take overall responsibility for the sales, service and product support functions of our Projection Screens and Advaning divisions.

The selected candidate will lead the entire Sales and Product Support teams, drive B2B and B2C business growth, ensure timely installation and service support, and remain accountable for team performance and customer satisfaction.

* **Training and improvement:** Train sales and product support staff, identify recurring technical or service issues, and implement corrective measures.
* **Management reporting:** Submit clear reports on sales performance, enquiry conversion, collections, installation progress, pending complaints and team productivity.

Qualifications and Experience

* Degree or Diploma in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics or a related discipline. Candidates with other qualifications and strong relevant technical experience may also be considered.
* Preferably **8–12 years of relevant experience**, including at least **3 years in a managerial role** leading sales and service teams.
* Proven experience handling both **B2B and B2C sales**, dealer networks, project business and direct customers.
* Experience in projection systems, audiovisual products, awnings, architectural products, automation or related technical products will be an advantage.
* Practical knowledge of site assessment, installation coordination, troubleshooting and customer complaint handling.

Essential Skills and Attributes

* Strong spoken and written communication skills in **English and Hindi**.
* Sound technical understanding and the ability to explain products clearly to customers and channel partners.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, planning and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel across India for business development, dealer visits, site inspections and service requirements.
* A hands-on approach, ownership of responsibilities and consistent follow-through.
* Ability to manage multiple product divisions and deliver measurable business results.

Key Performance Measures

Performance will be assessed against sales achievement, business growth, dealer development, enquiry conversion, timely collections, installation and service turnaround, customer satisfaction and team productivity.

**Compensation:** Commensurate with experience, technical competence and demonstrated ability to lead sales and service operations.

title: Process Engineering Specialist
description:
Turn complex business challenges into opportunities for meaningful transformation! Join Emapta as a **Process Reengineering Specialist** and lead process discovery, operational analysis, and AI opportunity assessments. Influence global business strategies, drive measurable efficiency improvements, and build a long-term international career where top 1% talent creates lasting business impact.

**Job Overview**

* Employment Type: Full-time
* Shift: Day Shift, Weekends Off

**Exciting Perks Await!**

* Competitive package
* Medical life insurance
* Standard government and Emapta benefits

* Mentorship and exposure to global leaders and teams
* Diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture
* Transparent performance management

**The Qualifications We Seek**

Educational Background

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Professional Experience

* At least 5 years of experience in process analysis, business analysis, or process improvement, preferably within BPO, shared services, or consulting environments
* Hands-on experience in operational process mapping and measurement, including transaction volumes, cycle times, and cost drivers
* Experience in identifying AI and automation opportunities and supporting their implementation

Technical & Analytical Skills

* Strong proficiency in process mapping and documentation using Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) or equivalent methodologies and tools, such as Visio, Lucidchart, or Miro
* Strong analytical skills in data collection, baseline development, and benefit quantification
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate process discovery workshops and stakeholder discussions
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and their applications in operational processes
* Proficiency in time-and-motion studies and data triangulation techniques to establish reliable, evidence-based baselines
* Ability to assess, score, and prioritize improvement opportunities based on business value, feasibility, and organizational readiness

Preferred Qualifications

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or an equivalent process improvement qualification
* Experience with process mining tools, such as Celonis or UiPath Process Mining
* Familiarity with workflow automation platforms, such as n8n or Microsoft Power Automate

**YOUR DAILY TASKS:**

Discovery Planning & Execution

* Design discovery plans for each engagement, including project scope, methodologies, data requirements, stakeholder maps, and sprint schedules, in coordination with the Vice President, Digital Solutions.
* Lead structured discovery sprints with client teams through facilitated workshops, stakeholder interviews, side-by-side observations, and time-and-motion studies.
* Conduct data-driven process discovery alongside qualitative assessments by extracting and analyzing system data, applying process mining where event data is available, and cross-validating evidence to ensure reliable findings.
* Map current-state business processes according to consistent standards and document transaction volumes, cycle times, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and cost drivers.

Opportunity Assessment

* Apply the team's assessment methodology to evaluate and score improvement opportunities based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and change impact.
* Establish quantified operational baselines and develop benefit hypotheses for each opportunity to support subsequent verification by the Value & Excellence Office.
* Develop opportunity heatmaps across business processes and functions to demonstrate the scale and location of potential AI-driven improvements to executive stakeholders.
* Validate the technical feasibility of shortlisted opportunities with the AI Engineering team before their inclusion in transformation roadmaps.

Read-Out & Roadmap Support

* Prepare comprehensive discovery reports, opportunity portfolios, prioritized transformation roadmaps, and supporting evidence for all presented metrics.
* Present detailed findings to client project teams and support the Vice President, Digital Solutions, and Transformation Advisor during executive presentations.
* Translate approved transformation roadmaps into implementation-ready documentation, including process specifications, operational baselines, and measurable success criteria for delivery teams.

Growth & Pre-Sales Support

* Support business development initiatives through scoped discovery previews, project effort estimates, and process analysis content for client proposals.
* Develop and maintain reusable discovery toolkits, process patterns, and industry reference models to accelerate future engagements and strengthen proposal quality.

Internal Efficiency Support

* Apply established process discovery and analysis methodologies to Emapta's internal operations as directed.
* Follow the Value & Excellence Office's discovery standards to ensure accurate, measurable, and independently verifiable internal operational baselines.

Other Responsibilities

* Perform additional duties as assigned by authorized company representatives through direct written instructions or verbal assignments.

**Role Dimensions**

Project Scope

* Deliver process discovery and business analysis across multiple concurrent client engagements within the Digital Solutioning & AI Advisory team.
* Support internal operational efficiency initiatives as directed.

Business Impact

* Establish accurate operational baselines and credible opportunity assessments to strengthen the quality and reliability of Emapta Labs' transformation proposals.
* Provide defensible, evidence-based analyses to enable subsequent verification of realized business benefits.

Decision-Making Authority

* Own process mapping methodologies and maintain analysis quality throughout assigned engagements.
* Escalate decisions related to project scope, commercial considerations, and opportunity prioritization to the Vice President, Digital Solutions.

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) or equivalent methodologies and tools, such as Visio, Lucidchart, or Miro?

description:
**Job Title: Branch Manager – Coworking Operations**

**Company:** Betaspace Coworking  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-time, on-site  
**Experience:** 5+ years, including branch or facility management  
**Reporting to:** Operations Head / Management  
Contact Number : 0091 9500 8187 02

**About Betaspace**

Betaspace provides managed offices, private offices, coworking desks, meeting rooms, and virtual office services. We focus on delivering well-maintained workspaces, reliable facilities, and responsive client service.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced Branch Manager to take ownership of a Betaspace branch’s operations, team performance, client experience, occupancy, and collections follow-up.

You will lead the branch team, maintain service standards, resolve operational issues, control approved expenses, and support business growth through effective enquiry handling, client retention, and renewals.

This is an active leadership role requiring regular branch inspections, direct team supervision, sound judgement, and accountability for results.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**1. Branch Ownership and Operational Management**

* Take overall responsibility for the assigned branch’s daily operations and performance.
* Ensure the branch is clean, organised, fully functional, and ready for clients.
* Conduct regular walkthroughs and review opening, operating, and closing checks.
* Establish clear work priorities, assign responsibilities, and verify completion.
* Anticipate operational needs and address gaps before they affect clients.
* Implement company policies and approved operating procedures consistently.

**2. Team Leadership and Performance**

* Lead admin executives, housekeeping, security, and other assigned support staff.
* Set clear expectations, allocate work, and monitor service quality.
* Plan attendance coverage, shifts, leave arrangements, and staff handovers.
* Review daily reports and verify that reported work has been completed.
* Coach team members and conduct regular performance discussions.
* Address performance gaps and recommend training, staffing, or corrective action to management.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of branch employees.

**3. Housekeeping and Workspace Standards**

* Maintain consistent standards across reception, cabins, workstations, meeting rooms, pantry, washrooms, and common areas.
* Oversee daily cleaning schedules, periodic deep cleaning, and inspection checklists.
* Ensure cleaning gaps are corrected and recurring issues are addressed.
* Monitor workspace appearance, furniture condition, signage, and overall ambience.
* Ensure available spaces are maintained to the same standard as occupied areas.

**4. Client Relationships and Service Standards**

* Build professional relationships with client representatives and key contacts.
* Take ownership of escalated complaints and coordinate timely resolution.
* Track client concerns, commitments, and service requests through completion.
* Conduct periodic feedback discussions to understand satisfaction and changing requirements.
* Coordinate approved workspace changes and additional service requests.
* Identify dissatisfaction or potential exits early and develop retention actions with management.

**5. Occupancy, Enquiries, and Business Growth**

* Maintain accurate occupancy and availability records for seats, cabins, and offices.
* Oversee enquiry response, branch tours, proposals, and prospective client follow-ups.
* Coordinate with sales and management to convert suitable enquiries into bookings.
* Monitor upcoming vacancies, move-ins, expansions, and move-outs.
* Identify opportunities for additional seats, meeting room use, and other relevant services.
* Work towards occupancy and revenue targets agreed with management.
* Offer pricing, discounts, or commercial commitments only within approved authority.

**6. Collections Follow-up and Renewals**

* Review outstanding payments with the accounts team and assign follow-up actions.
* Ensure invoices and payment reminders reach the appropriate client contacts.
* Track payment commitments and escalate overdue or disputed amounts promptly.
* Coordinate clarification of billing concerns with accounts and management.
* Plan renewal discussions before agreements expire.
* Maintain visibility of renewal status, potential exits, and revenue risks.
* Implement access-related actions only through approved company procedures.

**7. Facilities and Preventive Maintenance**

* Oversee the operational readiness of internet, Wi-Fi, AC, lighting, drinking water, washrooms, access systems, and other facilities.
* Coordinate UPS, generator, CCTV, electrical, and other technical servicing with authorised personnel.
* Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, service records, and applicable AMC details.
* Plan maintenance activities to minimise disruption to clients.
* Monitor breakdowns, response times, recurring faults, and repair completion.
* Escalate infrastructure risks with practical recommendations and cost estimates.

**8. Vendor and Building Coordination**

* Manage branch-level coordination with technicians, suppliers, service providers, and building representatives.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations based on cost, quality, and service requirements.
* Seek approvals before confirming purchases or work beyond delegated limits.
* Monitor vendor attendance, timelines, work quality, and completion.
* Verify supporting bills and work completion before recommending payment.
* Coordinate building-related matters such as shared facilities, parking, access, and maintenance.

**9. Client Onboarding, Bookings, and Exits**

* Oversee workspace preparation and smooth onboarding of new clients.
* Ensure documentation, access cards, keys, and handover records are coordinated.
* Review meeting room bookings, day passes, and workspace allocations.
* Ensure client commitments are communicated clearly to the branch team.
* Supervise exit inspections, asset checks, access returns, and handovers.
* Coordinate financial closure with accounts and management.

**10. Expense Control, Procurement, and Inventory**

* Monitor branch operating expenses against approved budgets.
* Review purchase requests, stock requirements, and petty cash records.
* Ensure expenses have appropriate approvals and supporting documents.
* Maintain accountability for furniture, equipment, keys, access cards, and consumables.
* Prevent avoidable wastage, stock shortages, and unnecessary expenditure.
* Recommend cost improvements while maintaining service standards.

**11. Safety, Security, and Incident Management**

* Oversee visitor management, access control, and security coordination.
* Ensure emergency contacts are available and exits remain unobstructed.
* Report hazards, damage, security concerns, and significant incidents immediately.
* Coordinate incident response according to company procedures.
* Maintain incident records and follow up on corrective actions.
* Ensure staff understand their responsibilities during emergencies.

**5. Facilities and Maintenance Management**

**6. Vendor and Service Provider Coordination**

* Schedule work to minimise inconvenience to clients.

* Escalate vendor delays and repeated service failures.

**7. Enquiries, Branch Tours, and Occupancy Support**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Government Tender & GeM Executive** to manage end-to-end government tendering activities, including **GeM, CPPP/e-Procurement and State Government tender portals**.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying suitable government tenders, evaluating eligibility, preparing technical and commercial bids, coordinating required documents, submitting bids within deadlines, and following up until order execution and payment realization.

The Government e-Procurement portal supports online tender searching, tender document downloads and online bid submission, making hands-on e-procurement experience important for this position.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Search and identify relevant **Government, PSU and institutional tenders**.
* Monitor **GeM, CPPP/e-Procurement and State Government tender portals** regularly.
* Study tender documents, specifications, eligibility criteria, terms & conditions and deadlines.
* Evaluate tender requirements and prepare a **Tender Eligibility / Compliance Sheet**.
* Prepare and submit **Technical Bids and Commercial/Financial Bids**.
* Prepare BOQ, price comparison, cost sheets and quotation documents.
* Coordinate with the **Technical, Accounts, Purchase, Production and Management teams** for required information and approvals.
* Collect and maintain tender-related documents such as:
* Company registration documents
* GST, PAN and MSME certificates
* OEM authorization
* Product datasheets
* Experience certificates
* Turnover certificates
* Technical compliance documents
* EMD / Tender Fee documents
* Other declarations and undertakings
* Handle **GeM Bid, Custom Bid, Reverse Auction and other applicable bid processes**.
* Manage and update **GeM product catalogue/listings**, product specifications, pricing and supporting documents.
* Upload invoices and manage post-order documentation on GeM where applicable.
* Track tender corrigenda, pre-bid clarifications, submission deadlines and bid opening dates.
* Monitor bid status and coordinate for further requirements after submission.
* Follow up on **Purchase Orders, contracts, delivery schedules, invoices and payment realization**.
* Maintain a proper database of submitted tenders, bid status, results and upcoming opportunities.
* Prepare regular **Tender MIS Reports** for management.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of tender documents and commercial information.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in **GeM Portal**.
* Experience in **Government Tender / E-Tender / E-Procurement** activities.

title: Liaison Executive
description:
**Land Due Diligence & Legal Documentation**

* Procure and verify revenue documents: Patta/Chitta, FMB sketches, TSLR extracts, Encumbrance Certificates (EC), and sub-division records.
* Coordinate with the Tahsildar, Sub-Registrar Office, and Village Administrative Officers (VAO).
* Work closely with legal advocates to obtain legal search reports/title opinions.
* Assist in drafting, finalizing, and executing Joint Development Agreements (JDA/JV), Memorandums of Understanding (MOU), General Power of Attorney (GPA), Agreements to Sell, and Sale Deeds.
* Prepare board resolutions, partner/director KYC dossiers, and company statutory filings (ROC, PAN, TAN, GST).

**2. Project Approvals & Statutory NOCs**

* Prepare and submit approval dossiers to Local Planning Authorities (LPA / DTCP / Municipal Corporation).
* Liaison with government departments to obtain statutory NOCs:
* Tahsildar / Revenue Department
* Fire & Rescue Services
* Police Department
* Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA / TNPCB for CTE & CTO)
* Airports Authority of India (AAI)
* Department of Geology and Mining
* Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, and soil test agencies for drawings, stability certificates, and compliance affidavits.

**3. RERA & Statutory Compliance**

* Compile and coordinate application filings for **TNRERA** project registration.
* Coordinate between architects, project planners, and banks for quarterly updates and project timelines.
* Obtain Project Completion Certificates (CC) and TNRERA Completion Certificates.
* Manage project registrations with the Labour Office and BOCW (Building and Other Construction Workers) welfare board.
* Facilitate opening, MOD handling, and closure of project RERA bank accounts.

**4. Utilities & Handover Liaison**

* Coordinate permanent infrastructure connections prior to unit handovers:
* TNEB permanent grid power connection
* Corporation / TWAD permanent drinking water connection and meter installation
* Underground sewerage connection (UGSS)
* Facilitate initial property tax assessments with the local municipal authority.
* Assist in registration and paperwork for Apartment Owners’ Association formation under the Societies Registration Act.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **Experience:** 3–7+ years of hands-on liaisoning and documentation experience in the Tamil Nadu real estate / construction industry.
* **Knowledge:** Strong practical knowledge of Tamil Nadu land revenue terms (Patta, Chitta, TSLR, FMB), registration processes, LPA/DTCP planning norms, and TNRERA compliance.
* **Network:** Established working familiarity with local municipal corporations, revenue departments, EB, and regulatory boards in and around Coimbatore / Tamil Nadu.
* **Skills:** Strong negotiation, problem-solving, and coordination skills; proficient in Tamil and English (written and verbal).

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

**Company:** D A R Jewellery  
**Location:** Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu  
**Job Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Experience:** 3–5 years preferred in jewellery retail, staff training, or showroom operations  
**Salary:** Based on experience and industry expertise

About the Role

D A R Jewellery is looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Jewellery Showroom Staff Trainer to train and develop our showroom employees. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of jewellery retail operations, customer handling, sales techniques, and staff performance improvement.

The candidate will be responsible for improving the sales team's product knowledge, customer service standards, communication skills, and overall showroom sales performance.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct training sessions for jewellery showroom sales executives and other retail staff.
* Train employees on gold, silver, diamond, and antique jewellery product knowledge.
* Educate staff on 22-carat gold, BIS 916 hallmarking, HUID, jewellery pricing, making charges, and wastage calculations.
* Develop effective customer handling, communication, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Train employees to identify customer needs and recommend suitable jewellery products.
* Improve upselling, cross-selling, customer conversion, and average bill value.
* Train staff on showroom etiquette, grooming, professional behaviour, and customer experience.
* Conduct onboarding and induction programmes for new employees.
* Prepare training materials, product knowledge guides, presentations, and sales scripts.
* Evaluate employee performance through assessments, role-plays, and practical demonstrations.
* Conduct regular refresher training and identify individual training requirements.
* Coordinate with showroom managers to identify sales performance gaps and implement improvement plans.
* Monitor the impact of training on sales targets, customer satisfaction, and employee productivity.
* Travel to different showroom locations for staff training whenever required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 3–5 years of experience in jewellery retail, showroom operations, staff training, or sales development preferred.
* Strong knowledge of gold jewellery and jewellery showroom sales processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to train, motivate, and coach employees.
* Strong understanding of customer service and retail sales techniques.
* Good organisational and reporting skills.
* Ability to conduct practical training sessions and assess employee performance.
* Willingness to travel to company showrooms when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Improvement in showroom sales performance after training.
* Increase in customer conversion rates.

title: Store Keeping Executive
description:
**Designation:** Store Keeping Executive  
**Department:** Inventory / Operations  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Reporting To:** Operations In-Charge  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Store Keeping Executive to manage daily store operations, inventory records, stock movements, billing activities, and related documentation. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate stock records, verifying incoming and outgoing materials, preparing invoices, and ensuring proper coordination with the Accounts, Sales, Purchase, and Dispatch teams.

The ideal candidate should have good organizational skills, basic computer knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate inventory and billing records.

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Stock and Inventory Management**

* Maintain accurate and updated stock records in the inventory system, Excel, or stock register.
* Record all stock inward and outward transactions promptly.
* Verify received materials against purchase orders, invoices, and delivery challans.
* Ensure materials are issued only against authorized requests or approved documents.
* Monitor stock availability and identify low-stock items.
* Conduct periodic physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
* Maintain records of damaged, returned, rejected, and excess materials.
* Ensure proper storage, identification, labeling, and organization of materials.

**B. Billing and Invoice Management**

* Prepare sales bills and invoices using the company's billing software.
* Verify product details, quantities, prices, customer information, and applicable taxes.
* Ensure that billing records match the actual materials supplied.
* Prepare delivery challans and other dispatch-related documents as required.
* Maintain invoice records and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with the Accounts team to resolve billing discrepancies.
* Ensure that all billing transactions are recorded accurately and on time.

**C. Goods Receipt and Dispatch Coordination**

* Receive materials from suppliers and verify quantity and condition.
* Prepare or maintain Goods Received Notes (GRNs), wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with the Sales and Dispatch teams for timely material movement.
* Verify materials before dispatch and ensure the correct quantity is issued.
* Maintain proper records of deliveries, returns, replacements, and material transfers.
* Report shortages, damaged goods, and discrepancies to the reporting manager.

**D. Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain purchase invoices, sales bills, stock registers, delivery challans, and other store documents.
* Prepare daily stock inward and outward reports.
* Maintain daily billing summaries and closing stock reports as required.
* Prepare low-stock reports and communicate replenishment requirements.
* Maintain accurate digital and physical records for audits and management reviews.
* Submit daily and periodic reports within the prescribed timelines.

**E. Store Maintenance and Coordination**

* Keep the store clean, organized, and properly maintained.
* Ensure materials are stored safely and can be easily identified and retrieved.
* Coordinate with the Purchase team regarding pending supplies and replenishment requirements.
* Support the Accounts team with billing records and supporting documents.
* Communicate stock availability and dispatch status to relevant departments.
* Follow company procedures for inventory control, billing, documentation, and material handling.

**3. Qualifications and Skills Required**

* Minimum qualification: Any UG Degree.
* Prior experience in storekeeping, inventory management, billing, or warehouse operations is preferred.
* Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in MS Excel.
* Knowledge of invoice preparation, stock registers, and delivery documentation.
* Good numerical ability and attention to detail.
* Strong organizational and record-maintenance skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments.
* Honest, responsible, punctual, and systematic in handling stock and documentation.

4. Expected Outcomes

* Accurate and updated inventory records.
* Error-free billing and proper invoice documentation.
* Controlled and traceable stock movements.
* Timely identification of stock shortages and discrepancies.
* Organized store operations and reliable reporting.
* Smooth coordination between store operations and other departments.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

description:
Job description:

**About SuperLabs**

SuperLabs is an engineering & IT consulting firm. To know more about SuperLabs & the work we do visit Featured Work

* Business Development Manager — eCommerce / D2C Sales
* Company: SuperLabs
* Business Unit: SuperCommerce
* Location: On-site only — Thane or Coimbatore
* Role Type: Full-time
* Experience: 10 years
* preferred Function: Business Development, B2B Sales, eCommerce Sales, C suite Outreach
* Notes compensation is benchmarked to your current salary & negotiations can range between 10% to 35% from fixed pay.

**About SuperCommerce**

* SuperCommerce is a SuperLabs business unit focused on helping serious eCommerce and D2C brands improve growth, conversion, retention, analytics, checkout, technology infrastructure, and commerce operations. To know more about SuperLabs you can check out https://superlabs.co/
* We work with founders, CXOs, CMOs, CTOs, Heads of Growth, and eCommerce leaders to identify revenue leakage and improve commerce performance across websites, mobile apps, analytics, CRO, CRM, retention, subscriptions, marketplaces, and growth operations. We are now hiring a Business Development Manager to help us build a strong pipeline of high-quality eCommerce and D2C brands.

**About the Role**

* We are looking for a sharp, persistent, and commercially-minded Business Development Manager — eCommerce / D2C Sales to identify, research, reach, and qualify serious eCommerce brands for SuperCommerce.
* This is not a generic lead generation role.Your job is not just to send emails or book random meetings. Your job is to create qualified business opportunities with the right founders, CXOs, growth leaders, and eCommerce decision-makers.
* SuperCommerce leadership will initially lead final closing conversations, but you will be responsible for creating and advancing the pipeline that leads to paid audits, advisory, and implementation opportunities.
* Core Mission : Your mission is to build a qualified eCommerce founder/CXO pipeline that converts into paid SuperCommerce engagements.

**You will own the journey from:**

* Account research → decision-maker mapping → personalized outreach → qualification → discovery support → proposal follow-up → conversion support

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Build the Target Account List**

* Research and build a high-quality list of eCommerce and D2C brands that fit the SuperCommerce ICP.
* Target accounts may include: D2C brands, Marketplace-led brands, Beauty, fashion, personal care, food, lifestyle, electronics, home, wellness, and consumer brands
* Brands doing meaningful online revenue
* Indian brands first, with global expansion potential later
* You will identify the right decision-makers, including: Founders, CEOs, CMOs, CTOs, Heads of Growth, Heads of eCommerce, Marketing leaders, Digital transformation leader

**2. Research Business Problems**

Before outreach, you should be able to study a brand and identify possible business angles.This may include:

* Website conversion gaps
* Product page issues
* Checkout friction
* Cart abandonment
* Retention gaps
* Weak CRM flows
* Poor analytics visibility
* Mobile app opportunities
* Subscription opportunities
* Marketplace expansion opportunities
* Slow or outdated commerce infrastructure

You do not need to be a senior consultant, but you must be able to understand eCommerce business problems beyond “they need marketing.”

**3. Run Founder and CXO Outreach**

* You will create and execute outreach through: LinkedIn, Email, Founder networks, Referrals, Commerce communities, Podcast/community invitations, Agency and consultant networks
* Your outreach should be specific, sharp, and relevant to the brand.
* We do not want generic spam messages.

**4. Qualify Opportunities**

* You will help qualify whether a prospect is worth leadership time.
* A qualified opportunity should usually have:
* A serious eCommerce or D2C business
* A relevant decision-maker
* A clear business problem or growth opportunity
* Interest in audit, advisory, growth, technology, analytics, or commerce improvement
* Potential to convert into a paid SuperCommerce engagement

**5. Support Discovery and Proposal Movement**

You will support SuperCommerce leadership before and after discovery calls. This includes:

* Preparing pre-call account notes
* Summarizing brand research
* Documenting call notes
* Tracking objections
* Following up professionally
* Sharing relevant materials
* Keeping CRM updated
* Helping move opportunities toward paid conversion

**6. Maintain CRM and Weekly Pipeline Reports**

You will be expected to maintain clean pipeline records. This includes:

* Target accounts
* Contact details
* Outreach status
* Follow-up dates
* Call outcomes
* Opportunity stage
* Proposal status
* Expected deal value
* Conversion status
* What Success Looks Like

**First 30 Days**

* Understand SuperCommerce positioning and offers
* Build 150–200 qualified target accounts
* Map 300–500 decision-makers
* Start personalized outreach
* Create clean CRM tracking
* Generate first qualified founder/CXO conversations

**First 60 Days**

* Build 300–400 qualified target accounts
* Create a steady outbound rhythm
* Support 10–15 qualified discovery conversations
* Help identify 3–5 proposal opportunities
* Improve messaging based on response quality
* First 90 Days
* Build 500+ qualified target accounts
* Support 25–40 qualified founder/CXO conversations
* Help convert 1–3 paid audits or diagnostics
* Create ₹1Cr–₹5Cr in qualified pipeline
* Establish a repeatable outreach and follow-up process

**Performance incentives are additional**

* Indicative incentive structure:
* Paid audit / diagnostic collected: incentive based on collected value
* Advisory retainer converted: incentive based on first collected invoice
* Implementation project converted: incentive based on first collected invoice
* Expansion or repeat engagement converted: incentive based on collected value
* Final incentive structure will be discussed during the hiring process.

**Required Experience**

You should have experience in at least one of the following:

* B2B sales
* Business development
* Enterprise eCommerce sales
* D2C brand outreach
* SaaS sales
* Agency sales
* Performance marketing sales
* CRM / retention / CRO sales
* Founder or CXO outreach
* Lead generation & business qualification
* Strong Fit Backgrounds

You may be a strong fit if you have worked in:

* Shopify agency
* D2C growth agency
* Performance marketing agency
* eCommerce development agency
* B2B SaaS company
* CRM / retention / loyalty company
* CRO or analytics company
* Marketplace services company
* Founder-led consulting or advisory business

**Required Skills**

You should be able to:

* Research eCommerce brands properly
* Identify relevant decision-makers
* Write clear emails and LinkedIn messages
* Understand basic eCommerce metrics
* Speak professionally with founders and senior leaders
* Ask good qualification questions
* Follow up consistently
* Maintain CRM discipline
* Work with weekly targets
* Take feedback and improve messaging quickly
* Work full-time from office in Thane or Coimbatore
* Ecommerce Knowledge Required

You should understand or be willing to quickly learn terms such as: CAC, AOV, LTV, Conversion rate, Cart abandonment, Checkout drop-off, Repeat purchase rate, Retention, CRM, CRO, Product page optimization, Shopify / Shopify Plus, GA4, Klaviyo, Hotjar / Microsoft Clarity, Marketplace commerce

**This Role Is Not For You If**

Please do not apply if:

* You are looking for remote-only work
* You only want to book meetings and not care about conversion
* You send the same generic message to every prospect
* You cannot write professional emails
* You are uncomfortable with daily outreach
* You do not like follow-ups
* You cannot maintain CRM updates
* You have no interest in eCommerce or D2C brands
* You only understand social media marketing and not business problems
* You are not comfortable being measured on commercial outcomes
* You expect inbound leads to be provided every day

**Application Questions**

Please answer the following questions clearly while applying. Vague or incomplete answers may lead to rejection.  
1. Have you done B2B sales, business development, or founder/CXO outreach before?

Share 2 examples.

2. What type of companies have you sold to or reached out to before?

Mention industry, buyer type, and average deal size if applicable.

3. Explain CAC, AOV, conversion rate, and repeat purchase rate in simple terms.

4. Pick any 5 Indian D2C or eCommerce brands that SuperCommerce should target.

For each brand, mention why they may be relevant.

5. Write a cold LinkedIn message to the founder of a ₹100Cr skincare or fashion brand asking for a conversation with SuperCommerce.

6. A founder says, “We already have a marketing agency and a tech team.” How would you respond?

7. Create a simple 7-day outreach plan to reach eCommerce founders and senior leaders.

8. What is the best commercial outcome you have helped create in a previous role?

Mention pipeline, revenue, conversion, deal value, or business result if available.

9. Are you willing to work full-time from our office in Thane or Coimbatore?

Mention your preferred location: Thane, Coimbatore, or either location.

10. Share a 2-minute video explaining why an eCommerce founder should speak to SuperCommerce.

Ideal Candidate

* The ideal candidate is someone who can say:
* “I can research serious eCommerce brands, identify the right founders and decision-makers, create relevant outreach, qualify opportunities properly, follow up with discipline, and help convert conversations into commercial SuperCommerce engagements.”
* We are looking for someone who is commercially hungry, detail-oriented, persistent, and excited to help build a new business unit from the ground up.

description:
**Job Description**: **B2C Sales Consultant**

**Company**: Birdscale Technology and services

**Job Title**: B2C Sales Consultant

**Location**: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type**: Full-Time

**Overall Experience**:\*10+ years preferred; candidates with 8+ years of relevant experience may be considered. Exceptional candidates may be considered with flexibility on the overall experience requirement.

**Salary:**\* ₹45,000 – ₹1,00,000 per month

**Qualification**:\* Any qualification

**About** **Birdscale** -

Birdscale is a Coimbatore-based \*Drone Survey and Geospatial Mapping Company\*. We help landowners, builders, farmers, and infrastructure companies measure and map their land accurately with drone technology.

\***What we do**:\*

- Drone Topography Survey, Boundary Survey, Layout Marking

- Deliverables: Orthomosaic Map (GeoTIFF), Contour Map, 3D Model, Elevation Report, Boundary Marking on Ground

- Industries: Individual Plots, Real Estate Layouts, Farm Lands, House Construction, Small Commercial Projects

- Technology: Drone Photogrammetry, LiDAR, DGPS, RTK GPS, GIS

We are not a software company. We do real on-ground survey with our own drone team. Sales team is the bridge between customer who needs land measurement and our technical survey team.

**About the Role** - How B2C Works in Birdscale

In Birdscale, \*B2C means Direct to Landowner\*. This is not B2B corporate sales.

\*How you get customers:\*

A person in Coimbatore / Tirupur / Salem searches "land survey near me" or "plot measurement cost". They call us or fill form on our website / Justdial / Google Ad. That lead comes to you.

\***Your job is to convert that single enquiry into a paid survey:**\*

1. You call the customer in 10 minutes, understand his need - Is it for building a house? Selling plot? FMB sketch? Bank loan? Layout approval?

2. You explain Birdscale's process in simple language: "Sir, we will come with drone + GPS, measure your land, give you map with exact area and boundary stone marking"

3. You give price (e.g., Rs. 8k for 1 acre), handle price objection, and fix a date for survey.

4. On that date, you go to the field WITH our survey team, meet the customer at site, ensure survey is done smoothly, collect payment / advance.

5. After survey, you send the final map PDF to customer on WhatsApp and take Google Review.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

\*1. B2C Sales and Customer Acquisition\*

- Handle inbound B2C enquiries from Google Ads, Justdial, Website, Referrals.

- Call, qualify, and convert individual customers - Land owners, farmers, builders, agents.

- Achieve daily / weekly / monthly sales targets (e.g., 15-20 site bookings per month).

- Manage complete cycle: Lead -> Call -> Quotation -> Site Visit -> Payment Collection -> Map Delivery.

\*2. Cold Calling and Outbound Calling\*

- Call old enquiries, missed calls, and past customers for referral business.

- Follow up with warm leads who asked for price but did not book.

- Explain value clearly: Accuracy vs manual chain measurement, legal validity, quick delivery.

\*3. Lead Generation and Local Networking\*

- Build network with local sources: Village VAO, Document Writers, Real Estate Agents, Civil Engineers, Architects.

- Generate referral business from these local partners.

- Put up flex / do small awareness activity in new layout areas.

\*4. Negotiation and Closing\*

- Negotiate price within given band, handle objections like "local surveyor charges less".

- Close on the spot and collect advance to block survey slot.

\*5. Reporting\*

- Update daily call report, site visits, and bookings in Google Sheet / CRM.

- Report conversion rate and market price feedback.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

- Strong verbal communication in \*Tamil and English is a MUST\*. Hindi is an added advantage.

- 8-10+ years proven experience in \*B2C Field Sales\* - Real Estate, Insurance, Home Loans, Building Materials, Survey Equipment, Agri-products preferred.

- Comfortable with both phone sales and daily field visits.

- Negotiation and closing skills - Can ask for advance and payment.

- Target-oriented, self-motivated, and honest with customer handling.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Job Description: Executive Assistant

Department: Executive Office / Corporate Management

Designation: Executive Assistant to the CEO

Reporting To: CEO

Employment Type: Full Time

Work Location: Coimbatore

Experience: 2 to 3 Years Preferred

Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Management, Commerce, or a related discipline, having knowledge in legal and finance.

1. Job Purpose

**Job Purpose:**

To provide administrative and operational support to senior management by managing schedules, coordinating meetings, tracking assignments, maintaining confidentiality, and ensuring smooth communication and timely completion of key tasks.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Executive and Administrative Support

● Manage the executive's daily calendar, appointments, meetings, and schedules.

● Organize business meetings, conferences, appointments, and official engagements.

● Prepare daily schedules, meeting agendas, and briefing notes.

● Handle incoming calls, emails, correspondence, and official communications.

● Draft professional emails, letters, reports, presentations, and other business documents.

● Maintain an organized filing system for physical and digital records.

● Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including tickets, accommodation, and itineraries, when required.

B. Meeting and Calendar Management

● Schedule internal and external meetings with appropriate stakeholders.

● Communicate meeting details and ensure the availability of required participants.

● Prepare agendas and supporting documents before meetings.

● Record meeting minutes, decisions, responsibilities, and deadlines.

● Follow up with concerned individuals on pending action items.

● Maintain a meeting calendar and provide timely reminders to management.

C. Management Coordination and Follow Up

● Coordinate with departmental heads, employees, business partners, and external stakeholders.

● Track assignments delegated by senior management.

● Maintain a follow up tracker for pending tasks, deadlines, and deliverables.

● Obtain progress updates from responsible team members.

● Escalate delayed assignments, critical issues, and time sensitive matters to management.

● Ensure that important instructions and decisions are communicated accurately.

● Assist management in monitoring the implementation of business decisions.

D. Business and Operational Support

● Support the planning and execution of management initiatives and business projects.

● Assist in preparing business reports, presentations, proposals, and management updates.

● Coordinate with HR, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Operations, and other departments.

● Assist in organizing corporate events, investor meetings, client meetings, and official engagements.

● Maintain records of important business contacts and stakeholder communications.

● Support the preparation and tracking of operational documents.

● Identify administrative bottlenecks and recommend improvements to executive office processes.

E. Communication and Stakeholder Management

● Serve as a professional point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.

● Maintain effective communication between senior management and relevant teams.

● Handle routine enquiries and route important matters to the appropriate person.

● Coordinate appointments with clients, investors, business associates, and strategic partners.

● Maintain professional communication standards across email, telephone, and messaging platforms.

● Ensure timely responses and follow ups on important communications.

F. Documentation and Reporting

● Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly executive activity reports as required.

● Maintain records of meetings, decisions, commitments, and pending assignments.

● Prepare presentations, spreadsheets, and management summaries.

● Maintain document version control and ensure important records are easily accessible.

● Assist in collecting information required for management reviews and decision making.

● Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality of executive office documentation.

G. Confidentiality and Professional Conduct

● Maintain strict confidentiality regarding business strategies, financial information, personnel matters, investor details, and management decisions.

● Handle sensitive documents and communications responsibly.

● Exercise discretion when dealing with confidential or commercially sensitive matters.

● Follow company policies, procedures, and professional standards.

● Maintain integrity, reliability, and accountability in all assigned responsibilities.

3. Daily Workflow

Morning: Planning and Prioritization

● Review the executive's calendar and daily priorities.

● Identify important meetings, appointments, and deadlines.

● Prepare the day's schedule and required documents.

● Review pending tasks and follow up with concerned departments.

During the Day: Coordination and Execution

● Coordinate meetings, calls, and appointments.

● Manage correspondence and administrative requirements.

● Follow up on delegated assignments.

● Coordinate with departmental heads and stakeholders.

● Update task trackers and communicate urgent matters.

End of Day: Review and Reporting

● Review the status of completed and pending assignments.

● Update the executive's task and follow up tracker.

● Highlight unresolved issues and upcoming deadlines.

● Prepare a brief end of day report.

● Organize the schedule and priorities for the following working day.

4. Key Performance Indicators

The Executive Assistant's performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

1. **Calendar Management:** Accuracy of scheduling and avoidance of preventable scheduling conflicts.

2. **Task Follow Up:** Timely tracking and follow up of assignments delegated by management.

3. **Communication Efficiency:** Timeliness, accuracy, and professionalism of communications.

4. **Meeting Coordination:** Effective preparation, scheduling, documentation, and follow up.

5. **Reporting Accuracy:** Quality and timely submission of reports and management updates.

6. **Administrative Efficiency:** Ability to organize documents, schedules, and executive office activities.

7. **Deadline Management:** Effectiveness in tracking important deadlines and escalating delays.

8. **Confidentiality:** Compliance with company confidentiality requirements.

9. **Stakeholder Coordination:** Quality of interaction with employees, clients, business partners, and other stakeholders.

10. **Proactiveness:** Ability to anticipate requirements, identify issues, and initiate appropriate follow up.

5. Required Skills and Competencies

Technical Skills

● Proficiency in Microsoft Office and AI tools

● Working knowledge of email and calendar management tools.

● Ability to prepare reports, presentations, and business documents.

● Familiarity with task management tools and digital filing systems.

● Good typing, documentation, and record management skills.

Professional Skills

● Excellent verbal and written communication.

● Strong organizational and time management abilities.

● Effective multitasking and prioritization.

● Professional telephone and email etiquette.

● Attention to detail and accuracy.

● Problem solving and decision making abilities.

● Strong interpersonal and coordination skills.

● Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Personal Attributes

● High integrity and trustworthiness.

● Proactive and solution oriented mindset.

● Professional appearance and conduct.

● Calmness under pressure.

● Adaptability and willingness to learn.

● Ownership of assigned responsibilities.

● Respect for confidentiality and organizational hierarchy.

6. Qualifications and Experience

Educational Qualification

● Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or expertise in legal and finance

● Additional certification in executive assistance, office administration, or business management is an advantage.

Experience

● 2 to 3 years of relevant experience in executive assistance, administrative management, or corporate coordination is preferred.

● Experience supporting a Director, Chairman, CEO, or Vice President is desirable.

● Experience in investment, financial services, real estate, or corporate environments is an added advantage.

7. Authority and Reporting Structure

The Executive Assistant will report directly to the designated executive and work closely with relevant departmental heads.

The role may involve:

● Coordinating information and updates across departments.

● Requesting progress reports on assignments delegated by management.

● Scheduling meetings and appointments on behalf of the executive.

● Maintaining task trackers and highlighting overdue assignments.

● Communicating management instructions accurately.

● Escalating urgent matters and operational concerns.

**Note:** The Executive Assistant is responsible for coordination and follow up, not independently exercising managerial authority unless specifically delegated.

8. Expected Outcomes

The successful candidate is expected to:

● Improve the executive's productivity and time management.

● Ensure that meetings, schedules, and commitments are properly organized.

● Maintain consistent follow up on management decisions and assignments.

● Improve communication between leadership and departments.

● Maintain accurate and accessible executive records.

● Protect confidential business information.

● Help ensure that important tasks and deadlines receive appropriate attention.

9. Overall Expectation

The Executive Assistant must function as a dependable professional partner to senior management, ensuring that administrative responsibilities, communication, coordination, and follow up are handled efficiently.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate initiative, discretion, accountability, and the ability to anticipate management requirements while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism.
